title: Two monster black holes could collide in just 100 years
caption:
Astronomers tracking galaxy Markarian 501 found evidence of a second particle jet hidden behind the first. Its 121-day orbital wobble suggests two supermassive black holes could fuse in as little as 100 years.

Source: Sciencedaily - Two monster black holes could collide in just 100 years
